_comment: Curated log of real compiler/runtime bugs found by the fuzzers. Newest first. report.py renders this into FUZZRESULTS.md — keep entries short; the fix commit/PR carries the detail.

findings.title: HTTP/1.1 client (http_pure.nu): the chunk-size parser had no overflow ceiling — a 16/17-digit size wrapped i64 to a negative chunk_remaining and the body copy moved the read position 2^62 bytes back (SEGV on any build, from one response). It now takes 1*HEXDIG under a 2^48 ceiling plus BWS/extensions only, checks the CRLF after each chunk, and caps chunk-size/trailer lines (8 KiB) and the response head (256 KiB)
findings.status: fixed (http_client_chunked_strict); target http1resp, minutes into its first run

findings.title: RSA verify (rsa.nu) spent sig^e mod n on any key a peer sent: a 600-bit exponent made one certificate-chain or CSR signature check take most of a second at 2048 bits (~50x e = 65537) with nothing bounding the modulus either, and e = 1 was accepted, under which sig = EM verifies anything. Verify now refuses a modulus over 8192 bits and an exponent outside odd 3 .. 2^32-1
findings.severity: dos + forgery under a degenerate key
findings.status: fixed (rsa_pubkey_bounds); found chasing the csr target's low throughput

findings.title: Borrow-checker blind spot: a definite double free inside a `;` defer body was accepted whenever the defer was written in a `?` arm, a `??` arm, a `~` body or a foreach body — the exit-state replay only walked a site whose synthetic arming flag was DEFINITELY set, and each of those four contexts weakens or drops it. Conditionally-armed bodies are now swept body-local, from an EMPTY state, like a `??` arm
findings.status: fixed (borrow_defer_nested_context); 12 of 400 seeds, the first weekly CI fuzz finding

findings.title: Borrow-checker blind spot: a definite double free inside a closure body was accepted — one flag meant both 'this belongs to the closure' and 'record nothing', so the checker was off for everything written in a closure. The body now gets its own recording context and its own analyze pass

Borrow-checker blind spot: a definite double free inside a `??` arm was accepted — arms were a state-preserving black box because payload bindings have no `let` row. Each arm is now walked from an EMPTY state, so only arm-local bindings are tracked and nothing can be conflated

A generic named `[T]` has its VALUE-position `T` — the boolean literal — rewritten by monomorphisation, so `? T { … }` becomes `? i { … }` and the instantiation fails against source nobody wrote. The diagnostic now names the collision
findings.status: fixed (diag_generic_tparam_bool_name); the underlying lexer ambiguity remains

findings.title: A nested field could be READ but not WRITTEN: `= . . o inner x v` died with "cannot assign to a field of ''" because the object of a nested path is a by-value register, not a binding with an alloca. The chain is now walked by address

A closure body emitted the ENCLOSING frame's drop battery: a `^`-bodied closure literal written after an owned value (`% Drop`, String, owned struct field) ended the lifted function with `load %DH, %DH* %r2` against an alloca that only exists in the caller — invalid IR at best, use-after-scope plus a double drop had the register resolved
findings.status: fixed (3 of the first 25 seeds; closure_body_outer_drops)

findings.title: `break` / `continue` were rejected in every foreach body — the spec scopes both to "the innermost enclosing `~` loop body" and a foreach is one, but only the while form published the labels; the foreach's hidden index bump lived in the body's fall-through, so a `continue` would have skipped it. The bump now has its own landing pad

A struct whose NAME is tparam-shaped (`P`, `Q3`) could not be a generic type argument: instantiation was decided by spelling, so `( Vec P )` was skipped as still-abstract and died on `type 'Vec__P' has no field 'ctl'` inside the stdlib. Now decided by scope

Constant out-of-range shift in a match guard (`>> <i32-payload> 34`): -O0 "worked", -O1 aborted, -O2 segfaulted with a wild jump — branch-on-poison UB; now a compile error, and mixed-width binop registers (24 build-fails/1000 seeds as invalid IR) are rejected like the float/bool/pointer mixes
Assignment to an undefined identifier was silently discarded — RHS evaluated, no store, no diagnostic (exposed by the fuzzer's minimizer, whose deletions kept compiling through the hole)

Narrow-int enum payload slots stored non-canonically: `@ E { V 151 }` (i8 payload) kept raw 151 while the pattern binding reconstructed -105, so a literal constraint failed to match the value it names
Field/element stores emitted the RHS without width coercion — an i32 value stored into an i16 field produced invalid IR (clang reject); all 8 store paths in gen_field_store affected
A `;` defer anywhere in a function disabled EVERY auto-drop in it (strings, struct fields, %Drop values, closure envs, slices) — loop-body %Drop values leaked per iteration
A defer inside an inner scope emitted `br label %fn_cleanup` with no such block — invalid IR; defers now carry reachability-armed flags and a function-lifetime chain
Seven miscompiles in integer codegen: width-coercion, unsigned div/rem/shift/compare selection, mixed signed/unsigned operands (the campaign that motivated signedness-in-the-type-representation)
findings.status: fixed (pinned by cast_*.nu and the signedness regression tests)

findings.title: X.509/DER, CBOR, msgpack, JSON, YAML, XML, TOML mutational campaign (~5300 inputs under ASan+UBSan): no crash, OOB, UB, or hang
